prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an almost finished visual-novel CG. Make ONE localized correction: fix the walking orientation of the anonymous male stretcher bearer at the rear/right end of the stretcher, currently seen from the back in an olive jacket and dark trousers.
He and Jessy MUST BOTH FACE AND WALK IN THE SAME DIRECTION, toward the foreground-left/lower-left, away from the TARDIS. Jessy is the leading/front bearer; the anonymous man follows at the rear, both moving forward together along the stretcher's long axis. Reorient ONLY the rear man's body, hips, shoulders, legs and head so that we see his FRONT or three-quarter FRONT, facing diagonally toward the lower-left just like Jessy, instead of his back. His arms naturally reach forward/down to firmly carry the rear handles, supporting the stretcher at the same height as Jessy. His olive jacket must show the front opening/chest rather than a large backpack covering his back. A backpack, if retained, is behind his body and mostly hidden. His posture, grip, anatomy, load-bearing and walking direction must be physically coherent. Both men carry the patient forward; they do not face opposite ways, and do not face each other.
Preserve ALL the rest: Jessy's exact face, worried searching gaze, hair, beard, glasses, Hawaiian shirt, navy shorts, pose and front grip; the elderly patient, blanket, stretcher and its perspective; every other survivor, distressed families, crowd positions; the blue open TARDIS and golden interior; the rocks, vegetation, sea, cliffs; exactly the same TWO suns and their positions; composition, framing, lighting, colors, linework and painterly anime CG style. Keep the picture's current landscape aspect ratio and dimensions, no crop and no reframing. Do not redraw or change unaffected areas. No extra people or limbs, no new accessories, no text, no border, no watermark. Opaque background.

history.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: finished cinematic Ren'Py CG, wide 16:9 opaque illustration, ideally 1920 x 1080.
Primary request: a heartbreaking catastrophic evacuation aftermath: Jessy helps carry an exhausted injured survivor while desperately looking for his missing friends among the arriving refugees.
Input images: Image 1 is a CHARACTER IDENTITY AND OUTFIT reference for Jessy, not an edit target. Image 2 is the EXACT LOCATION AND LIGHTING reference: the wild alien shore before human reconstruction. Image 3 is a STYLE AND TARDIS reference from the preceding rescue CG, not an edit target. Create a new scene on the alien beach, not on collapsing Earth.
Jessy must look unmistakably like image 1: young adult man, tousled dark brown hair, rectangular dark glasses, full dark beard, beige short-sleeved Hawaiian shirt with green palm trees, pale blue flowers and waves, navy cargo shorts. Same anime face and proportions. He is in the foreground left/center, helping carry the near end of a makeshift blanket stretcher with an exhausted injured elderly survivor; another anonymous adult refugee carries the far end. His hands firmly grip the stretcher, but his head is turned toward the new arrivals behind him, eyes wide, brow creased, visibly devastated and searching familiar faces. Sorrow, fatigue, helplessness and urgent compassion, no triumphant hero pose, no smile. His face and the helping action must both read clearly.
On the beach around him: scattered civilian survivors from contemporary Japan, dusty everyday clothes, small bags, blankets, some seated in shock, some quietly embracing, others supporting injured companions or looking for family. Small personal belongings left on sand. Convey that people have just lost their entire world. No gore, no graphic injuries, no corpses.
In the middle-right background the familiar blue police-box TARDIS has its door open with a warm golden interior; a small stream of survivors is stepping onto the sand. The same blue cabin as image 3, no magical portal. Do not feature Laplage; he is still carrying out evacuations. Do not include Ilona or Alexandre, who are missing; no additional recognizable main characters.
Environment must follow image 2: untouched sandy and rocky alien coast, the same huge shore boulder and wild coastal plants, sea and natural cliffs, no human city, buildings, roads or rescue infrastructure. Exactly TWO suns visible in the sky: a larger orange-red disk low near the water and a smaller pale-yellow disk above to the right. No giant planets, no destroyed Earth in the sky, no third sun. Warm twilight light and reflections should feel beautiful but indifferent to human tragedy.
Style: polished detailed hand-drawn anime visual-novel CG matching the existing rescue illustration, fine dark lines, painterly cel shading, expressive faces, coherent anatomy and perspective. Slightly subdued warm amber and cool purple colors, emotionally heavy and intimate amid a larger crowd. A single full-frame scene with strong depth, not a collage. Keep Jessy's face, the stretcher occupant's face and the clearest arriving refugees above the lower 25 percent so the dialogue box will not cover them. No dialogue text, no captions, no UI, no logos, no watermark, no border.
